QuestInfo.name: [Maple Hero Quest] New Companion
QuestInfo.0: Talk to Mayple Terry to go to the Mini Forest of Endurance.\r\nOnce there, make your way to one of the mascot monsters at the top of the forest to receive a special gift.\r\nIt doesn't matter which monster you aim for, but maybe the monster you voted in the survey for has something to say to you?
